title: Creating a work order
intro: A work order is created on the New Work Order form, a five-step wizard: customer details, garments and measurements, fabric, shelf items, and a final review. No record is written until the review step is confirmed. This chapter covers the customer step, including the procedure when the mobile number is already held on file.

steps.title: Open the New Work Order form
steps.body: In the sidebar, select New Work Order (1). The form opens at the customer step.

steps.title: Enter the customer's name
steps.body: Enter the customer's full name (1). Only the name and the mobile number are mandatory. Other fields carry an asterisk but are not enforced.

steps.title: Enter the mobile number
steps.body: Retain the default country code, Kuwait +965, unless the customer holds a foreign number (1). Enter the mobile number (2). The system checks the number against existing records as it is entered. If the number is already held, the form is blocked; see section [[ref:01-take-order.duplicate-block]].

steps.title: Set nationality and account type
steps.body: Nationality defaults to Kuwait (1). Account Type (2) determines how the customer is recorded. A Primary account is a customer in their own right. A Secondary account belongs to a family and requires both a linked Primary account and a stated relation. The account type is never inferred; retain Primary unless the customer is known to belong to an existing family.

steps.title: Submit the customer details
steps.body: With the name and mobile number entered, select Confirm Customer (1).

steps.title: Confirm the customer record
steps.body: A confirmation dialog is displayed. Verify the details, then select Confirm (1). The customer record is created, the order is opened, and the form advances to the Measurement step. Select Cancel to return to the form without creating a record.

steps.title: Resolving a mobile number already on file
steps.body: Where the number entered at section [[ref:01-take-order.enter-mobile]] belongs to an existing customer, the form is blocked and the holder of the number is named. The order cannot proceed until one of three options is selected. Same customer (1) loads the existing record and continues the order against it. Family member (2) records a different individual who shares the number, for example a son using his father's telephone. It's a typo (3) closes the dialog so the number can be corrected.

steps.title: Link the customer as a family member
steps.body: Where Family member was selected at section [[ref:01-take-order.duplicate-block]], a relation must be recorded (1) before Link as family member (2) becomes available. The new customer is created as a Secondary account under the existing Primary.

steps.title: Select the relation
steps.body: Select the relation from the list (1): Son, Father, Cousin, Brother, Grandfather, Grandson, Nephew, Friend, or Others. Select Link as family member to apply it and continue with the order.
